title: 10 - Kafka Cluster (fully loaded)
description: Adapted from Confluent's own official reference dashboard (confluentinc/jmx-monitoring-stacks, jmxexporter-prometheus-grafana/assets/grafana/provisioning/dashboards/kafka-cluster-kraft.json - the KRaft variant, matching this cluster which has no ZooKeeper). Every panel was individually verified against this cluster's live Prometheus output before inclusion. Dropped entirely (confirmed not present, not faked): the whole Tiered Storage row (kafka_tier_tasks_* has zero registrations - tiered storage isn't enabled here), Linux disk read/write bytes (MBean not registered on this JVM/exporter combo - broker disk usage is covered via kubelet PVC stats in dashboards 03 and 22 instead), client-version tracking (no such metric here), and Acceptor Blocked Percentage (attribute not present). See this dashboard's own panel descriptions for the exact metric-name translations applied (this exporter uses generic name={...} labeled metrics, not the reference's specific-named ones).

panels.title: Errors per sec, by request type

panels.description: Reference used jvm_memory_used_bytes/jvm_memory_bytes_max - not present on the kafka broker container; this exporter's generic MBean conversion names it java_lang_memory_heapmemoryusage_*.
panels.title: JVM Heap Memory Used

panels.description: kafka_log_log_value{name="TierSize"} also exists but sums to exactly 0 cluster-wide - tiered storage is not enabled on this cluster, so it's omitted rather than shown as a permanently-flat line.
panels.title: Log size per Topic

panels.description: kafka_server_socket_server_metrics_* is a different (newer, richer) metric family than kafka_network_socketserver_value - this one carries per-listener/per-networkProcessor labels, which is what the reference dashboard's per-listener panels need.
panels.title: Connections count per listener

panels.description: Non-zero here means producers are sending an older message format than the broker's log format and the broker is doing an expensive down-conversion - worth alerting on in a real deployment.
panels.title: Produce message conversions per sec
